title: What's New
items: Faster Sheets and Analyses: Results of recent queries are remembered and reused — switching tabs, scrolling back, and repeating a question no longer re-read your data, so large datasets respond much faster, especially on Windows.
Smoother Analysis Tabs: Analysis results load page by page like sheets — see the total row count, sort any column, and scroll through very large results without slowing the app down.
See What Is Running: A live timer in the sheet footer and a "Running query" indicator in the status bar show when a query is still working, even after you switch tabs.

Full Results When You Create a Sheet or Download: Creating a sheet or downloading a CSV from an analysis now includes all rows by default instead of stopping at 10,000, with a confirmation to keep the limit if you prefer.
Troubleshoot Screen: Shows how much of your recent work is served instantly from memory, with a button to clear it.

title: Fixes
items: AI answers failing with an "Invalid JSON" error on sheets with certain numeric columns are fixed.
Saving project settings (grid colours, number and date formats) failed for some users after an earlier update — fixed.
Analyses that return no rows showed a row-count error — fixed.
Switching tabs quickly could briefly show another tab's rows — fixed.
The app icon now displays correctly at every size on Windows and meets the macOS App Store sizing rules.
Errors across the app are reported more completely so support can resolve issues faster.
